minutes.headline: Panel votes Brooks House and TC Pacios unfit for town hall use, but flags TCP for community-use study
minutes.summary: The Municipal Building Design Committee voted that neither the Brooks House nor the TC Pacios building, in its current state, has municipal/town-hall use, while separately voting that TC Pacios may still support community activities (teen center, food pantry, senior programs) pending further cost and condition study. Members discussed demolition versus renovation costs for both buildings, the town's failure so far to coordinate with the town clerk, food pantry and teen center about relocation, and set August 17th as the next meeting to work on square-footage needs for future municipal building options.

what_happened.line: The committee voted that neither Brooks House nor the current TC Pacios building is fit for town hall use.
It separately voted TC Pacios might still support community programs like the teen center and food pantry, pending further study.
Members agreed to draft cost options for both a renovated or new municipal building and a separate community reuse of TC Pacios.
The panel set August 17th to work out square-footage needs from existing floor plans before those options go further.

why_it_matters: This bears on where town hall ends up and what residents will eventually be asked to fund, whether that is new construction, an addition, or a renovation.
The community-use finding on TC Pacios matters directly to the food pantry and teen center, both still searching for space and not yet coordinated with by the town on relocation.
Any demolition-versus-renovation numbers discussed at this meeting are estimates from committee conversation, not a town-approved cost, until an engineering study or town meeting article sets one.
